text.app-identity.ts: Holds the app name Lantern and the folder under the system's app-data directory where the app keeps its data, fixed in one place so renaming the package never moves it
text.auth-expiry.ts: Decides whether a token's expiry date is far off, within 14 days or past, and reads and writes the manual expiry date
text.auth-expiry.ts gotcha: A manual expiry date means the end of that day in UTC.
text.auth-input.ts: Validates what is pasted for a GitHub, Bitbucket or Jira account: the token, the Atlassian email or GitHub's optional commit email, a Jira site that can only be a name.atlassian.net address, a nickname and an expiry date, with the refusal texts from the catalogue
text.auth-kinds.ts: Defines each set of auth kinds once as a constant object with a derived type: check failures, error codes, connection states, binding choices, persistence, credential kinds, sources and refusals, expiry sources and levels
text.auth-view.ts: Defines what the window receives about accounts and projects, and the replies of the account channels, so the renderer never imports the main process
text.auth.ts: Names the account IPC channels shared by the main process and the preload
text.code-highlighting.ts: Defines source provenance and semantic-highlight request, result and span contracts
text.code-preview.ts: Shares file-preview line and byte limits across the application
text.config.ts: Defines the dev-profile flag, the profile's local port (any free one, while the installed app keeps a fixed port) and endpoint, the notification kill switch and the Claude settings path
text.config.ts gotcha: Env is read once at load; LANTERN_NOTIFICATIONS unset is silent only in dev, whose port 0 is any free port.
text.control-characters.ts: Tells whether a text holds a control character (a code up to 31 or 127) and strips them, so one line checks need no regular expression.
text.lantern-main-links.ts: Holds the main-link rule, the fewest pairs carrying 80% of the relation lines up to twice the node count, that both the calm feature view and the areas view use.
text.lantern-names.ts: Turns feature, area, foundation, platform and outside system ids into the readable names the Macro view shows.
text.lantern-plan-fix.ts: Writes the one text handed to an agent to fix a plan file (its path, slug, every problem or the parse error, and what to do), says which plan file names an agent may edit and builds the broken-plan entry with the warning that names the file.
text.lantern-plan-messages.ts: Reads the plan messages, including the plan view's own text, from the skill's messages.json through typed code tables, so the app parser, the loader and the renderer speak like the scripts.
text.markdown-render.ts: Turns Markdown into safe HTML, escaping raw HTML and images and keeping only http, mailto and anchor links
text.memory.ts: Defines the memory view's plain-data snapshot types, its sampling interval and old-and-large thresholds, its IPC channel names, the old-and-large rule and the result of freeing a project's memory
text.pr-explain.ts: Defines the explain-a-file channel names, the request, saved-result and completion shapes, the id and commit patterns, the four explanation sections with their headings and plain-text form, the new-file Before text, and the rule that a saved explanation is stale for another head commit
text.project-data.ts: Names the .lantern/.project folder that holds a project's local app data and its explains subfolder, for the main process and the empty-state text alike
text.providers.ts: The one table of GitHub, Jira and Bitbucket with their name, role, hosts, git remote host and its aliases, token page, the fields a token needs and whether the commit email is optional, which code host a pull request record's URL names, and the constants code switches on instead of a bare provider string
text.rtk.ts: Defines the plain RTK status data (found, path, version, edition, hook files, reason) shared by main and renderer
text.settings-graph.ts: Declares the Graph category and its folder folding setting with default and description
text.settings-notifications.ts: Declares the Notifications category: the cards switch, animations, follow-cursor, screen position, dismiss time, volume and a sound timbre per card kind, with the card kinds and timbres they pick from
text.settings-registry.ts: Registers settings nodes into typed keys, defaults and lookups, rejecting duplicate, malformed or mis-prefixed keys; shortcut lists type as key bindings.
text.settings-tabs.ts: Declares the Project tabs category: whether idle project tabs are closed (off by default) and after how many minutes
text.settings-schema.ts: Defines the boolean, string, number and key-bindings setting schemas, including a string's previewable and placement-picker flags, and the settings node shape
text.settings-schema.ts gotcha: Enum lists must be declared as const, or SettingValue types the setting as string
text.extension-problem.ts: Turns the refusal of an extra skill name (bad, locked or repeated) or of a skill to switch off (not switchable or repeated) into its catalogue message, the one wording the main process and the add-skill step share
text.extension-slots.ts: Names the extension slots (delegate, orchestrator, reviewer), the global and project scopes, the merge of two lists (first list first, each name once), the locked prefix and the check, against the locked list it is given, that an extra skill is a plain, unlocked, unique folder name, and that a skill to switch off is one the slot lists as switchable and not repeated, that the skill linker setting is an absolute path, plus the three states the linker can be in
text.tray-action.ts: Names the few actions the menu bar popover may ask the app for and reads one back from its id, accepting a test card only for a kind the menu offered
text.tray-keys.ts: Decides what a key does in the menu bar popover: arrows and Tab move with wrap-around, Home and End jump, Enter opens the selected item and Escape closes, and keeps the selection on the same item when the list changes
text.tray-model.ts: Turns the projects and their sessions into what the menu bar popover shows: sections for what needs you, what is working, what finished and the rest, each project on its most urgent state with the count of sessions in it, a shortened path, the number of sessions needing you and the colour of the most urgent one, whether anything can be cleared, and the test cards on offer
text.shell-quote.ts: Wraps a value in single quotes for a POSIX shell command, escaping embedded quotes
text.local-review.ts: Defines the local comparison id, its parsing from an id or a typed spec, ref validation and the shapes of a comparison stat, ref list and commit
text.settings-reasons.ts: Declares the Generated reasons category: the longest reply and the most diff characters one reasons run may use, with defaults and limits
text.reason.ts: Holds the longest allowed reason, 160 characters, and the rule text telling Claude to write one plain sentence saying why a file changed, not what changed
text.platform.ts: Defines the windows, mac or linux platform name, VS Code's without Web, and turns Node's platform string into it, so key labels and shortcut dispatch agree on the operating system.
